IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ResponsibilityTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [AssetID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [SecurityAsset] [char](1) NOT NULL, [SecurityAssetID] [int] NOT NULL, [Context] [nvarchar](max) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ), CONSTRAINT [UQ_ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED ( [ResponsibilityTypeID] ASC, [AssetID] ASC, [SecurityAsset] ASC, [SecurityAssetID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem_SecurityAsset-SecurityAssetID-AssetID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem_SecurityAsset-SecurityAssetID-AssetID] ON [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] ( [SecurityAsset] ASC, [SecurityAssetID] ASC, [AssetID] ASC ) INCLUDE([ResponsibilityTypeID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem]') AND name = 'UpdatedBy' ) BEGIN alter table [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] add [UpdatedBy] int not null default(0) END
IF NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem]') AND name = 'UpdatedOn' ) BEGIN alter table [dbo].[ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem] add [UpdatedOn] datetime not null default(getutcdate()) END
